population.purpose: Add regular and hidden divergence context to adverse checkpoints and first causal turn entries without changing the frozen M7C proxy or treating replay events as genuine Mochipoyo alerts.

research_question: Do regular or hidden divergences help distinguish recoverable pullbacks from failing adverse paths?
At the first causal turn, do supportive divergences improve return, MFE/MAE or recovery probability beyond distance-only information?
Are divergence effects stable by ticker, direction, timeframe, oscillator and month?

pivot_proxies.note: These are independent causal pivot proxies, not a claim to reproduce proprietary TradingView/MT5 ZigZag deviation behavior.

definitions.BULLISH_REGULAR: second confirmed price low < first confirmed price low AND second oscillator value > first oscillator value
definitions.BULLISH_HIDDEN: second confirmed price low > first confirmed price low AND second oscillator value < first oscillator value
definitions.BEARISH_REGULAR: second confirmed price high > first confirmed price high AND second oscillator value < first oscillator value
definitions.BEARISH_HIDDEN: second confirmed price high < first confirmed price high AND second oscillator value > first oscillator value
